title: eSIM của tôi không hoạt động
pronunciation: ee-sim koo-ah toy khong hwat dohng
summary: For showing a phone shop, hotel desk, or carrier counter that the eSIM is installed but not connecting.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Open the cellular screen before asking so the problem is visible.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the eSIM setting, error message, or no-service bar. The screen will explain more than a long sentence.

phrases.vietnamese: eSIM của tôi không hoạt động

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: eSIM của tôi means my eSIM; không hoạt động means is not working.

breakdown.vietnamese: eSIM của tôi không hoạt động

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Wi-Fi password and SIM-card cards cover the setup questions that often come next.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at phone shops, airport SIM counters, hotel desks, cafes, and anywhere someone can look at the phone settings.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Connection problems may be activation, data, roaming, or coverage. Keep the settings screen open for the follow-up.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Move to battery, charger, charge-here, data-top-up, verification-code, or data-not-working cards if the issue changes.
